speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for sharing that history. To better understand your bleeding tendency, have you ever experienced excessive bleeding after minor cuts or surgeries like a tonsillectomy? Also, do you have any family members with similar symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old male. The patient was brought in by his mother for persistent bleeding following elective removal of wisdom teeth. The bleeding from the surrounding gums was minimally responsive to multiple gauze packs. The patient also has a history of easy bruising. Family history includes the patient's uncle who had similar issues with bleeding and a history of easy bruising and joint swelling.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemophilia A (Factor VIII deficiency). 

Based on the history of joint swelling in your uncle, a family history of bleeding, and your post-extraction bleeding with easy bruising, I strongly suspect an X-linked bleeding disorder like Hemophilia A. Have you ever noticed spontaneous bleeding into your joints or muscles without any injury?
